title: metaScreener: A Plugin-Based Desktop Application for Human-in-the-Loop Systematic Literature Screening
description: metaScreener is an open-source, cross-platform desktop application implemented in Python/Tkinter that delivers a sequential, multi-stage pipeline for systematic literature screening. The software integrates deterministic rule-based filters with large language model (LLM) inference to automate high-volume citation screening within structured evidence synthesis workflows. Its plugin architecture exposes seven interoperable modules covering citation extraction, reference resolution, eligibility criteria structuring, heuristic-based filtering, and LLM-based full-record eligibility adjudication. Each screening decision is logged within a timestamped, SHA-256-verified bundle archive that satisfies the audit and reproducibility requirements expected in rigorous evidence synthesis methodology.
